How it worksPrivacyOpen Haku

Privacy note

This note explains how Haku handles information on this website and in the Telegram Mini App.

Your reading answers

With current account consent, Haku saves your birth date, birth time or unknown-time choice, birth place, solar-term answer, relationship status, focus and duration. We use them to prefill future readings and generate your story. Without consent, they stay only in the current Mini App session.

Account information saved when you start reading

For a verified user without current consent, account and reading-detail storage is selected by default below Begin the story. Opening the page or verifying Telegram does not save anything. Only when you begin while it remains selected, or choose Save in My account, do we record consent and save Telegram ID, language, source Bot, visit times and the listed reading answers. Details remain with the account until HAKU_RETENTION_DAYS of inactivity, can be edited in My account, and are included in account export or deletion.

How long information is kept

Account records are automatically deleted 365 days after your last use.

Export or delete your account

At any time, open My account in the Mini App to use “Download my data” or “Delete my account”.

Cookies and external resources

This website does not use cookies and does not load third-party resources. The Mini App uses one necessary login cookie to maintain your session.

IP addresses and server logs

This website and the Mini App are delivered through Cloudflare, and our web server keeps access logs. Both process your IP address to deliver pages and protect the service. Only owner-role administrators can open individual reading details; every view is recorded in the audit log with the target Telegram ID, time and IP address. Audit logs also cover administrator sign-ins, failures and account exports.

Administrator access and logs

The admin area is limited to named administrator accounts. The system records administrator sign-ins, failed sign-in attempts, sign-outs, and data exports in its audit log.

Contact

For privacy questions, contact us at hello@truesignal.cc.

For reflection and entertainment. Not medical, financial or legal advice.
